answer: Because each onyx escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the prism ledger records every share and the hollow audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 5 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 94 aliases means 94 times 5 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 23 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
